source_title: Sananth reveals how Karthik Subbaraj’s trust helped him in 'Dorothy'
source_excerpt: Actor Sananth has spent nearly 15 years finding his place in Tamil cinema, but his role in 'Dorothy' has brought him a new level of recognition. Known for choosing different roles, the actor has won attention for playing Subbu, a transgender character in the film. The response has also marked an important moment in his acting journey, which began with short films before he moved on to feature films.Sananth has now become an actor that filmmakers looking for fresh performances are keen to work with. His journey reflects the value of patience and the importance of waiting for roles that challenge an actor.Sananth reveals how he prepared for his transgender role in 'Dorothy'Speaking about his experience of playing Subbu in 'Dorothy' with Cinema Vikatan, Sananth said the role came with a great deal of responsibility.
